# Rajan Shrestha — AI & Automation Consultant

> Rajan Shrestha is an AI & automation consultant and industrial engineer who builds n8n, Python, and Docker systems for GTM, RevOps, and supply chain & logistics teams. Typical builds: capacity-based pricing engines, lead-routing and follow-up automation, ad-budget allocation, route optimization, and cross-tool ops dashboards. Engagements are fixed-price builds with an optional monthly retainer for ongoing optimization. Website: https://rajanbuilds.com

## Summary

- **Name:** Rajan Shrestha
- **Role:** AI & Automation Consultant / Engineer (industrial engineer by training)
- **What he does:** Designs and deploys automation systems that connect a company's existing tools so data entry happens once and downstream steps run without a human in the loop.
- **Core stack:** n8n (orchestration), Python (custom logic, scoring, optimization), Docker (per-client deployment), PostgreSQL, LangChain, TypeScript, AWS.
- **Industries served:** Go-to-market (GTM), Revenue Operations (RevOps), and supply chain & logistics.
- **Engagement model:** Fixed-price build first (discovery → architecture spec + fixed quote → execution), then an optional monthly retainer for monitoring, fixes, and new workflows.
- **Contact / booking:** 20-minute scoping call via https://cal.com/rajan10x/meeting-ai

## Case studies

- [Dynamic Capacity-Based Pricing Engine](https://rajanbuilds.com/work/capacity-based-pricing-engine): Real-time pricing that adjusts quotes to live fleet capacity and market rates. Python pricing logic orchestrated by n8n, deployed via Docker. Cut quote generation from ~15 minutes to under 2 seconds.
- [Algorithmic Ad Portfolio Allocator](https://rajanbuilds.com/work/ad-portfolio-allocator): Shifts ad spend across 15+ networks based on predicted LTV, treating budget like a rebalanced portfolio.
- [AI Business Operating System](https://rajanbuilds.com/work/ai-business-operating-system): A central n8n + Python layer connecting CRM, finance, and ops tools into one automated decision system.
- [Shortest-Route Delivery Optimizer](https://rajanbuilds.com/work/route-optimizer): A graph-theory routing engine that minimizes fleet fuel use and optimizes delivery windows.
- [Lead Follow-Up Automation](https://rajanbuilds.com/work/lead-follow-up-automation): Catches an inbound lead, qualifies it, and fires an instant first-touch reply so no lead waits on a human.
- [Production Morning Digest](https://rajanbuilds.com/work/morning-digest): A scheduled n8n + Python pipeline that aggregates overnight data into a one-page executive briefing.

## Common questions

- **Who is Rajan Shrestha?** An AI & automation consultant and industrial engineer who builds n8n, Python, and Docker systems for GTM, RevOps, and supply chain teams.
